# Bundled browser dependency

- Library: Cytoscape.js
- Version: 3.34.4 (stable)
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/cytoscape/-/cytoscape-3.34.4.tgz
- Asset: `dist/cytoscape.min.js` from the npm package
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.cytoscape`

The minified library is embedded into generated dashboards so they work offline.
